svg.title: Reproduce the required real M4 gates
svg.desc: Use the runbook M4 required isolated chain reproduction section for actual paths and Linux/SSH/toolchain prerequisites. Build_m4.py obtains all pinned sources and builds providers plus a clean F1R3node with offline locked Cargo build after fetch. User/network namespaces must be available; generated keys/genesis stay inside ignored artifacts. verify_m4.py checks exact source start/end, runs full M1–M3.1 regression plus eleven commitment fixtures and six real native chain tests. It records positive observation timeouts separately from missing prerequisites and executed failures. Independent reproduction: <NATIVE_PYTHON> scripts/readback_m4.py <PRIVATE_READ_ACCESS_JSON> <SAME_ARTIFACT_JSON>, with reachable isolated node and retained post-state. Follow the runbook for the exact invocation and namespace access. Do not publish raw provider environments, journals or keys. Downloads may be warm; provider builds are fresh. This deck's export/check commands do not rerun integrations.
svg.text: Reproduce the required real M4 gates
Use tested 55ed540 or a reviewed descendant; fresh build/evidence destinations and authorized source access.
BUILD PINNED HIVE / DETTA / PLN + CLEAN F1R3NODE
VERIFY REGRESSIONS + NATIVE CHAIN + RECOVERY + READBACK
Read: manifest → same-artifact → readback → verification → regression summaries
Separate reader: scripts/readback_m4.py · DA get-only authority + read RPC · no caller journal or signer.
OMEGA × ASI / THROUGH M5 / runbook.md · build_m4.py · verify_m4.py
